book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: إيفان ديميتريتش، رجل عادي، دخله ألف ومئتين روبل بالسنة، وراضي.
sentences.en: Ivan Dmitritch, an ordinary man, with an income of twelve hundred a year, and content.
He sat after supper on the sofa.

sentences.ar: ومرته بتشيل الصحون، وقالت: نسيت أشوف الجريدة.
sentences.en: And his wife was clearing the plates, and said: I forgot to look in the paper.
Bring it, check the lottery numbers.
He said: what is the number of your ticket?

sentences.ar: وفتح الجريدة، وصار يمرر إصبعه على الأرقام.
sentences.en: And he opened the paper, and ran his finger down the numbers.

sentences.ar: وما كان بيصدق باليانصيب، وما كان بيتطلع عادة.
sentences.en: And he did not believe in the lottery, and never usually looked.

sentences.ar: بس هالمرة، ما كان عنده شي تاني يعمله.
sentences.en: But this time, he had nothing else to do.
And his wife dropped the plate, and said: 9499?
He said: yes. Wait. 9499. And the number... wait.
And he did not look at the number.

sentences.ar: لأنه، قبل ما يعرف، بده يستمتع بالأمل.
sentences.en: Because, before knowing, he wanted to enjoy the hope.
He said: the series is right!
And the two sat, and began to imagine.

sentences.ar: وهو بيتمدد بالحديقة، تحت شجرة، وبيشرب شاي، وولاده بيلعبوا.
sentences.en: And he lies in the garden, under a tree, drinking tea, his children playing.

sentences.ar: وحسّ بالشمس على وجهه، وهو قاعد بأوضة باردة برطرسبورغ.
sentences.en: And felt the sun on his face, sitting in a cold room in Petersburg.

sentences.ar: وقالت مرته: أنا كمان بدي أسافر.
sentences.en: And his wife said: I want to travel too.

sentences.ar: بس هي رح تحمل شناتي، وتحسب كل قرش، وتقول: كتير غالي.
sentences.en: But she will carry bags, count every penny, and say: too expensive.
And then, the ticket is hers.

sentences.ar: وهي رح تعطيني قليل، وتقول: هاي مصاريي.
sentences.en: And she will give me a little, and say: it is my money.

sentences.ar: أخوها، وأختها، وأمها، كلهم بيجوا، وبيبكوا، وبيطلبوا.
sentences.en: Her brother, her sister, her mother, all coming, weeping, asking.

sentences.ar: وتطلع فيها، وشافها عجوز، ومش حلوة، وبخيلة.
sentences.en: And looked at her, and saw her old, and plain, and mean.

sentences.ar: وهي تطلعت فيه، وفكرت نفس الشي: هو رح يصرف مصاريي، ويسافر لحاله.
sentences.en: And she looked at him, and thought the same: he will spend my money, and travel alone.

sentences.ar: وكرهوا بعض، لأول مرة بحياتهم، بلا سبب.
sentences.en: And they hated each other, for the first time in their lives, for no reason.

sentences.ar: قال إيفان ديميتريتش، بغضب: خلينا نشوف الرقم.
sentences.en: Ivan Dmitritch said, angrily: let us see the number.

sentences.ar: والأمل والكره راحوا مع بعض، بلحظة.
sentences.en: And the hope and the hatred went together, in an instant.

sentences.ar: وقعدوا الاتنين، والأوضة صارت أصغر، وأعتم، والعشا أطعم من قبل.
sentences.en: And the two sat, and the room seemed smaller, darker, and supper worse than before.
And he said: what a life!

sentences.ar: وقام، وقال: رايح أشنق حالي بأول شجرة.
sentences.en: And he got up, and said: I am going to hang myself on the first tree.
